top_signals.title: Trump won't extend Iran ceasefire, threatens to 'bomb' Oman if it 'gets in the way'
top_signals.summary: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Prabowo’s ‘Pragmatic’ Speech Comforts Weary Indonesia Investors
top_signals.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto’s annual speech on Friday was a rare uneventful affair, and that’s exactly what investors wanted to hear.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Options investors are betting on this trend in gold prices, Susquehanna says
top_signals.summary: Gold is seeing muted volatility, firmer upside skew and renewed inflows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Guggenheim Ties Sink Bonds of $135 Billion Insurer Sammons
top_signals.summary: Bonds of Sammons Financial Group fell to the lowest since they were issued in June after a report probed the life insurer’s connections to Mark Walter’s Guggenheim Partners.
